_description: Distilled AI Learning Codex. Zero-bloat knowledge repository containing running statistical medians, pacing constraints, 7-act retention formulas, and reference video blueprints.

pacing_rules.divider_rule_description: Every punctuation mark acts as a mandatory divider to create a new shot regardless of character shortness (e.g. 'Why?' is 4 chars, but gets its own shot). Non-punctuated text longer than 32 chars is subdivided at natural word boundaries targeting 16-32 chars per beat.

structure.name: The Modern Trap (Opening Hook)
structure.formula: Second-person indictment ('You'), relatable modern friction (phone screens, alarms, desks), followed by a sudden contrast snap into deep time.

structure.name: Dismantling the Myth via Hard Evidence
structure.formula: Take the standard conventional wisdom ('life was brutish and short') and shatter it using forensic or archaeological physical evidence (e.g. skeletal bioarchaeology, bone density vs. farmer arthritis).

structure.name: Sensory Day-in-the-Life Immersion
structure.formula: Walk through a vivid chronological day. Highlight an evolutionary superpower (e.g. full-body sweating and persistence hunting, sensory acuity).

structure.name: The Statistical Paradigm Shift
structure.formula: Cite rigorous empirical studies (stopwatch field research, global comparative data across cultures) that mathematically prove the counter-intuitive truth.

structure.name: The Human Core (Art, Leisure & Storytelling)
structure.formula: Explore what humans did with their abundance of free time (cave paintings, intricate crafts, games, firelight storytelling).

structure.name: The Biological Mismatch
structure.formula: Connect a modern medical/psychological ailment (insomnia, anxiety, chronic fatigue) to an ancient biological adaptation (e.g. biphasic sleep, the 1 AM Watch).

structure.name: The Trap Closes & Modern Irony
structure.formula: Show how progress created unintended entrapment (agriculture, granaries, walls, taxes), ending on a poignant philosophical irony about modern life.

visual_style.art_style: Minimalist hand-drawn 2D vector line art, bold black ink comic contours, expressive stick-figure characters (MinutePhysics & Casually Explained aesthetic).
visual_style.framing: Full bleed edge-to-edge illustration, grounded environment completely filling 16:9 widescreen frame without white matted borders or floating boxes.
visual_style.color_palette: Flat muted earthy tones (charcoal ink, paper parchment, ochre, terracotta, slate blue).
